title: fix(deps)!: patch x/crypto vulnerabilities
body:
## Summary

Fix the three x/crypto findings that failed [Trivy run 35101725841](https://github.com/gin-gonic/gin/actions/runs/35101725841): CVE-2026-56854, CVE-2026-56855, and CVE-2026-78662. Upgrade x/crypto from v0.53.0 to v0.56.0 and retain the x/net, x/sys, and x/text versions required by its module graph.

**Compatibility:** x/crypto v0.56.0 requires Go 1.26. Raise the module minimum and README requirement accordingly, and test Go 1.26/1.27 in CI. Security scanner settings remain unchanged.

## Pull Request Checklist

- [x] Open against master.
- [ ] All hosted CI checks pass (pending).
- [x] Existing tests cover this dependency-only update; no application logic changed.
- [x] No new feature documentation required.

## Scope and classification

Goal: resolve the reported security scan with the minimum patched dependency and align its required toolchain. No issue or Jira identifier supplied.

**Core change:** shared framework dependencies and minimum Go compatibility affect downstream users. Dependency maintenance is recurring; compatibility debt would propagate. Recommend two reviewers, including a module owner, with line-by-line review of the four-file diff.

## AI authorship

- Tool: OpenAI Codex.
- AI-authored files: go.mod, go.sum, README.md, .github/workflows/gin.yml.
- Human line-by-line reviewed: None — not yet reviewed by a human.

## Verification

Check out `fix/trivy-crypto-vulnerabilities` and run from the repository root. Prerequisites: Go 1.26.7 (Go 1.27.1 for the second toolchain check), golangci-lint v2.11.0, Trivy and network access for module/security databases. Local platform: macOS arm64. Local Trivy is v0.69.3; the original CI run used v0.70.0. No external services or credentials needed.

| Command | Expected / observed result | Status |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `go mod verify` | All modules verified | Passed |
| `go test ./...` | All package tests pass on Go 1.26.7 | Passed |
| `go test -race ./...` | All package tests pass, no race reports | Passed |
| `go test -tags nomsgpack ./...` | Alternate binding build passes | Passed |
| `go test -tags go_json ./...` | go-json backend tests pass | Passed |
| `go test -ldflags=-checklinkname=0 -tags sonic ./...` | Sonic backend tests pass | Passed |
| `GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.27.1 go test ./...` | All package tests pass | Passed |
| `golangci-lint run --timeout 5m` | v2.11.0 reports 0 issues | Passed |
| `trivy fs --scanners vuln,secret,misconfig --format table --severity CRITICAL,HIGH,MEDIUM --ignore-unfixed --exit-code 1 .` | Fresh database scan reports 0 vulnerabilities and exit 0 | Passed |
| `git diff --check` and staged equivalent | No whitespace errors | Passed |
| `make fmt-check` (supplemental, not a CI gate) | Existing alignment discrepancy in unchanged binding/binding_nomsgpack.go; reproduced from base HEAD using gofmt | Failed, pre-existing |
| Hosted Linux/macOS matrix | Entire matrix passes | Not run locally; PR CI pending |

Local commands used `GOCACHE=/tmp/gin-ci-gocache`; lint used `GOLANGCI_LINT_CACHE=/tmp/gin-ci-lint`; Trivy used `--cache-dir /tmp/gin-trivy-cache`. These only redirect caches.

### Regression scenario

1. On this branch, run `go list -m golang.org/x/crypto`; expect v0.56.0 (module manifest and resolved update verified).
2. Run the Trivy command above; expect exit 0 with no medium/high/critical fixed vulnerabilities. **Passed:** 0 vulnerabilities; the original run had 3.
3. Run both toolchain test commands above; expect all packages to pass. **Passed** on Go 1.26.7 and Go 1.27.1.

Cleanup: no application data created; only disposable tool caches. No secrets or security-sensitive application interfaces were added.

## Risk and rollback

Go 1.25 users must upgrade their toolchain. Review the dependency graph and minimum-version change carefully; checksums are generated by Go. Reverting this commit restores prior compatibility but also restores the reported vulnerable dependency versions.
